description: Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD) with his seven attached sources, matched on personId ALONE. The sibling fixture person-read-driscoll-attached-sources.json also requires `sourceDescriptions: true`, and `matches()` demands every predicate key be present (harness/fixtures.py:93), so a router that omits that optional argument matches nothing and gets a refusal. That is the wrong failure for a test about whether the router LOOKS before it searches, so this copy drops the argument from the predicate and keeps the same response. SD-DRIS-D is a Quebec civil death registration, which is what makes a death-record request on this person a request for something already attached.
